sentences.japanese: 君は彼女に、勝るとも劣らずかわいい。
sentences.english: You are not less pretty than her.

sentences.japanese: 彼はこの町で誰にも劣らず金持ちである。
sentences.english: He is as rich as any man in this town.

sentences.japanese: 彼は討論となると誰にも劣らない。
sentences.english: He is second to none when it comes to debating.

sentences.japanese: ぼくはこっちの方がそっちより品質が劣っていると思う。
sentences.english: I think this one is inferior to that in quality.

sentences.japanese: トムは彼のクラスではだれにも劣らないほど背が高い。
sentences.english: Tom is as tall as any student in his class is.
